```{r SetUp, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  comment = "#>", echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE
)

library(terra)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyterra)
library(DataExplorer)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)

# Load configuration and functions
source(here::here("config.R"))

```


```{r datapre}
# Load resampled raster datasets (AI, TWI, fused)
ai_5km_r <- terra::rast(ai_5km_file) * 0.0001 # Multiply all values by 0.0001 to get original value
flc_5km_r <- terra::rast(flc_5km_mosacic_file)[[1]]
cor_twi_vegh_5km_r <- terra::rast(cor_twi_vegh_mosaic_file)[[1]]
kmeans_8c_r <- terra::rast(kmeans_map_8c_path)
kmeans_12c_r <- terra::rast(kmeans_map_12c_path)

# Crop FLC raster to match extent of AI raster
flc_5km_r <- terra::crop(flc_5km_r, ai_5km_r)

# Stack rasters into a single SpatRaster
stacked <- c(cor_twi_vegh_5km_r,
             flc_5km_r,
             ai_5km_r,
             kmeans_8c_r,
             kmeans_12c_r)

# Convert to data frame for k-means clustering
df <- as.data.frame(stacked, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
colnames(df) <- c("lon", "lat", "cor", "fused", "ai", "cluster8c", "cluster12c")

```

```{r plotds}
# plot density
p_ds <- DataExplorer::plot_density(df)

# Combine the plot
cp_ds <- patchwork::wrap_plots(p_ds)

# Save plot
ggsave(
  filename = here::here("data/figures/03_4_kmeans_ds.png"),
  plot = cp_ds,
  width = 10,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in"
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = fused, fill = cluster12c)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster12c, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Fused distribution")

ggplot(df, aes(x = cor, fill = cluster12c)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster12c, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Correlation distribution")

ggplot(df, aes(x = ai, fill = cluster12c)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster12c, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Aridity index distribution")
```

```{r}
df$cluster8c <- factor(df$cluster8c)
df$cluster12c <- factor(df$cluster12c)

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cor, fused, ai),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  )
```

```{r var12c}
ref_line <- data.frame(variable = "cor", yint = 0)

p_var <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = cluster12c, y = value, fill = cluster12c)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6, color = NA) + 
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 2.5, 
               fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 0.5) + 
  geom_hline(data = ref_line, aes(yintercept = yint), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  facet_wrap( ~ variable,
              scales = "free",
              ncol = 1,
              labeller = as_labeller(c(
                cor = "Correlation", fused = "Fraction of Used Land", ai = "Aridity Index"
              ))) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"),
    name = "Cluster",
    na.value = NA) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 16), # facet 子图标签
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5), # 主标题
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15), # 坐标轴标题
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13), # 坐标轴刻度
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14), # 图例标题
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13) # 图例内容
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Variables Distribution by Cluster",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Cluster"
  )

# save density 
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(project_root, "data/figures/03_4_kmeans_var_dis.png"),
  plot = p_var,
  width = 10,
  height = 13,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in"
)

```

```{r}
# ---------- data pre ----------------------------------------------------------
# load coast outline, vector data
coast <- rnaturalearth::ne_coastline(scale = 110, returnclass = "sf")

# load correlation data, raster data
kmeans_r <- as.factor(terra::rast(kmeans_map_12c_path))

# ------- Plot global classification analysis ---------------------

# plot
p_kmeans <- ggplot() +
  tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data = kmeans_r, maxcell = Inf) +
  geom_sf(data = coast,
          colour = 'black',
          linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired"),
    name = "Cluster",
    na.value = NA,
    guide = guide_legend(
      title.position = "left",
      label.position = "bottom",
      nrow = 1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "K-means Classification Map (K=12)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    breaks = seq(-180, 180, by = 30)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(-60, 85),
    breaks = seq(-60, 90, by = 30)
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 24,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(b = 5)
    ),
    plot.title.position = "panel",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),

    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",

    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16,
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    ),
  )


# save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(project_root, "data/figures/03_4_kmeans_map_12c.png"),
  plot = p_kmeans,
  width = 24,
  height = 11.5,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in"
)


```
